description: Manages the various types or categories of documents within the system.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated and sortable list of document types. Optionally filters by a specific entity name to get document types relevant to that entity. This endpoint supports pagination and sorting to manage large result sets.

entityName.description: Optional filter to retrieve document types associated with a specific entity (e.g., 'Partner', 'Contact').

pageIndex.description: The 0-based index of the page to retrieve. Defaults to -1 (no pagination).

pageSize.description: The number of items per page. Defaults to 10.

orderBy.description: The field name to sort the results by (e.g., 'Name', 'Id').

ascending.description: Specifies the sort order: true for ascending, false for descending. Defaults to true.

example_uses: List document types for the 'Partner' entity, showing 20 per page.
Retrieve the first page of document types, sorted by name in ascending order.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch a list of document types, either globally or specific to an entity, with options for pagination and sorting.
